protocol.consensus_weight: validator self stake only; delegated stake excluded

probability.distinct_rounds: modeled as independent under RFC 9381 pseudorandomness and round-bound injective transcripts
probability.q768_note: ideal probabilities are used; the separately audited downward threshold approximation is negligible for topology-scale results

failure_model.correlated_outage: the named stake fraction is deterministically unavailable for voting and proposing
failure_model.byzantine: the coalition coordinates eligibility disclosure, proposal withholding, and vote withholding
failure_model.partition: messages do not cross partition; each side retains its own stake fraction
failure_model.honest_signing: honest validators do not sign conflicting finalized values

not_claimed: validator identities correspond one-to-one with operators
network addresses identify cloud provider, region, country, or ASN
the historical testnet topology predicts mainnet topology
independent validator failures approximate provider or operator outages
